csi.command.help:
=== Custom Start Inventory ===
/csi save [player] - Save inventory
/csi load [player] - Load inventory
/csi remove [player] - Remove saved inventory
/csi kit create <name> - Create kit from inventory
/csi kit <name> [player] - Give kit
/csi kit list - List all kits
/csi kit remove <name> - Remove kit
/csi kit remove all - Remove all kits
/csi kit reload - Reload configuration

The system automatically monitors inventory
